note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated outbound customs records with B/L numbers exist for Ecuador (HS 23099090, B/L 9552713, 2026-02-10) and Nepal (HS 30049085, B/L 9484855 and 8937783, Feb/Jan 2026). Note the declared HS 300490 is only partly matched — the Ecuador line is 23099090 (animal feed preparations), while the Nepal lines are 30049085 (within 3004). Per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be recorded as the actual mix (30049085 / 23099090) rather than a single 300490. The company is the Indian arm of French group Virbac SA (inbound rows from VIRBAC SA, Nice/Paris, France, HS 30049099 and 29225090), so it is a manufacturer-linked entity, not a pure trader. Caveat on the source counter: ImportKey reports 1897 total records but only 5 rows are visible on the free view, so the export picture is a sample, not a full count; the 1897 figure mixes imports and exports and must not be read as an export volume. Domestic India supply: no traces found in accessible sources — this is a data-access gap, not evidence of absence, hence 'unknown' rather than 'none_found'.
